comparison_gene_universe: intersection of primary and sensitivity tested stable gene_ids with finite log2FoldChange in both fits
primary_direction_concordance: same sign among genes with nonzero log2FoldChange in both fits; report exact-zero exclusions
effect_size_direction_subset: genes with abs(log2FoldChange) >= 1 in either fit, using the already frozen threshold-B magnitude; report subset size and zero exclusions
sign_reversal_definition: opposite signs among shared tested genes with finite nonzero log2FoldChange in both fits
significance_overlap: intersection, union, and Jaccard of the two tested-gene sets for padj < 0.05 and threshold B; use stable gene_id
interpretation: Any trigger warrants PASS WITH SENSITIVITY WARNING if both count-based models remain technically valid. A critical model/diagnostic failure instead requires REVIEW REQUIRED. DEG count alone does not decide status.
